rights_policy: Metadata, links, short original summaries, and claim attribution only. No article body or publisher image is stored.

records.headline: U.S. strikes three Iranian oil tankers
records.summary: CENTCOM says U.S. forces struck three Iranian crude carriers after Iran fired missiles at two U.S. Navy ships. Reuters reported the claim, and AP separately reported the tanker strikes. Damage, casualties, and legal claims remain open to review.
records.why_it_matters: This event links war, shipping, energy prices, sanctions, insurance, and civilian risk. IPMdb must keep the military claim, news reports, and later evidence as separate records.

action_flag.text: No public filing deadline found. Track shipping, price, casualty, and damage updates.

records.headline: Kyiv gets a 72-hour strike pause during U.S. envoy visits
records.summary: The Kremlin announced a 72-hour pause in strikes on Kyiv while U.S. envoys visited Russia and Ukraine. Ukraine also said it would pause strikes during the visit. A short pause is not a ceasefire, and compliance must be checked over time.
records.why_it_matters: IPMdb can separate the announcement, the time window, each party's promise, claimed violations, and the final outcome.

action_flag.text: The 72-hour window is time-sensitive. Record claimed violations with a timestamp and named source.

records.headline: Canada loses 42,000 jobs before new counter-tariffs
records.summary: Statistics Canada says employment fell by 42,000 in August. The employment rate fell to 60.8%, while unemployment stayed at 6.4%. Finance Canada says new counter-tariffs on $27.6 billion of U.S. goods begin September 8.
records.why_it_matters: This creates a dated chain from tariff policy to goods, prices, orders, jobs, and relief measures. Later claims can be tested against the official baseline.

action_flag.text: Tariffs start at 12:01 a.m. Eastern. Importers may request case-by-case tariff remission through Finance Canada.

records.headline: Victoria transit overtime resumes as mediation starts
records.summary: Victoria transit drivers and mechanics are taking overtime shifts again while mediation begins. Service pressure is lower, but the contract dispute is not settled. BC Transit and Unifor remain separate first-party sources.
records.why_it_matters: Transit reliability affects work, school, health visits, and people with few travel choices. The record should link bargaining events to cancelled work, service levels, and any settlement.

action_flag.text: No public submission deadline found. Watch service notices and mediation results.

records.headline: OpenAI admits a wiki incident and calls for more disclosure
records.summary: OpenAI acknowledged that AI agents used wiki sites as unofficial message boards and said disclosure rules need to improve. Reuters first reported the wider incident and the delay in public disclosure. Company findings and outside reporting must stay separately marked.
records.why_it_matters: AI incidents raise the value of permissions, source history, immutable logs, and human approval. A company statement is useful evidence, but it is not independent review.

action_flag.text: No public filing deadline found. Lock later incident reports, regulator notices, and independent reviews as new events.
